senses.en: to reach out to, to take by stretching out the hand
to reduce the price, to bargain
to eat soup or drink water, to imbibe

senses.zh: 設陷阱（埋設尖刺於路徑）
senses.en: to set up a type of trap
to breathe, to gasp, to pant
to break off with hands, to scrape off with hands, thresh with hands (as maize, millet, etc.)
to snatch away, to take by force, to rob
to pull out with effort (as a nail or a stake and the like)
to pull out without any effort (as a sword from the sheath or a piece of wire from a wire-net)
to pluck the feather of a fowl
